description: In tadpoles, depolarizing a cell population caused metastatic transformation of normal melanocytes without genetic change, and hyperpolarization prevented human oncogenes from inducing tumors (Levin's summary of Lobikin et al. and Chernet and Levin).
limitations: Reported secondhand here, from the author's own lab.

sources.locator: section Multicellularity vs. Cancer: The Shifting Boundary of the Self
sources.quote: human oncogenes which normally induce tumors can be prevented from doing so simply by optogenetic or constitutive hyperpolarization
